record.original_question: Let (W,S) be a Coxeter system with length function ell and reflection set T = {wsw^-1 : s in S, w in W}. It is known that sum_{u in W} x^{ell(u)} is a rational generating function. Determine whether sum_{t in T} x^{ell(t)} must also be a rational generating function.

evidence.quote: T := {wsw^-1 : s in S, w in W} be the set of reflections of W.
Problem 1.1. Let (W,S) be a Coxeter system. Is it true that then sum_{t in T} x^{ell(t)} is a rational generating function?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $(W,S)$ be a Coxeter system: $W$ is a group with a finite generating set $S$ subject only to relations of the form $(ss')^{m(s,s')} = e$, where $m(s,s) = 1$ and $m(s,s') = m(s',s) \in \{2,3,\ldots,\infty\}$ for $s \neq s'$ in $S$ (a relation is omitted when $m(s,s') = \infty$). For $w \in W$, let $\ell(w)$ denote the length of $w$, namely the smallest integer $k \geq 0$ such that $w = s_1 s_2 \cdots s_k$ with each $s_i \in S$. Let
\[ T \;=\; \{\, w s w^{-1} : s \in S,\ w \in W \,\} \]
be the set of reflections of $W$. It is known that the generating function
\[ \sum_{u \in W} x^{\ell(u)} \]
is a rational function of $x$. Determine whether, for every Coxeter system $(W,S)$, the generating function
\[ \sum_{t \in T} x^{\ell(t)} \]
is also a rational function of $x$.
artifact.status_search_result: The question (a conjecture attributed to Stembridge) appears to remain open in general. Recent work derives explicit rational expressions for the reflection-length Poincaré series in the affine case, but does not settle the general Coxeter-system question. Surveys of open problems on Coxeter groups list it as an unresolved problem.

status_evidence.title: On generating functions and automata associated to reflections in Coxeter systems
status_evidence.snippet: Inspired by a conjecture of Stembridge stating that the Poincaré series of reflections is rational, the authors focus on affine Coxeter groups and derive a simple formula for the Poincaré series in that case.
status_evidence.claim: The general rationality question is treated as a still-open conjecture (Stembridge); only the affine case is resolved here.

status_evidence.title: Some open problems on Coxeter groups and unimodality (arXiv:2410.09897)
status_evidence.snippet: Presents open problems on Coxeter groups and unimodality, together with main partial results and computational evidence.
status_evidence.claim: The rationality of the reflection-length generating function is listed as an open problem.
